name: Quick turns on another thread don't leave a long turn without check-ins
case: The agent works on one long turn for fifteen minutes, while a second agent session does a quick turn every couple of minutes. Boop keeps showing it's alive through the long turn: never more than about seven minutes of work without a reaction, whether to the quick turns or to the long one. The long turn's finish is a big moment, a success.
why: The working heartbeat waits from Boop's last reaction, not from the last event that woke the brain, so another thread's events can't starve a long turn of check-ins
